mapper.select: SELECT job_id FROM action_table WHERE delivered = 1 AND user_id = #{id}

select jd_sub_type,count(*) as number from job_table, favor, action_table where job_table.id = favor.job_id or (action_table.delivered = 1 and job_table.id = action_table.job_id) # and MONTH(action_table.updateTime) = '4' group by jd_sub_type order by count(*) desc limit 5

select resume.major, count(*) as count from action_table, resume where resume.user_id =action_table.user_id and (action_table.delivered = 1 and action_table.update_time > #{time}) group by major order by count desc limit 3
